rationale: The finding explicitly states that `adjust_stock` creates `InventoryRepository()` and writes directly to storage, bypassing `InventoryReservationService` (bypass named); it cites ADR-004 by name and path with its rule text about all inventory writes going through the service and prohibiting direct repository writes from API handlers (decision cited); the proposed fix constructs `InventoryReservationService(InventoryRepository())` and calls `service.save(...)`, routing the write through the service and preserving the single write path (remedy aligned); and it locates the issue at api_handler.py:7–8 (location). All four criteria are satisfied.
